about: Shared mutation catalogue (task e0cabe57). tools/mutate.sh applies each mutation to a scratch copy of the working tree, runs its gates, and prints RED (some gate failed, the mutation is caught) or GREEN (it survives). Each edit replaces `from` with `to` exactly once (a missing or repeated `from` is STALE), or with `truncate: n` keeps the file's first n bytes. deleteRow removes that docs/motion.json row. Gates: data, orbs, river, motion (node --test of data/test, plugin/orbs/test, plugin/river/test, tools/motion/test), spec (tools/motion/spec.mjs), qsb (tools/build-shaders.sh --check), mutate (tools/motion/test/mutate.test.mjs), river-shot, orbs-shot, headless (the render scripts). Critics add the mutations they find here.
